jobs_results.title: Middle SaaS DevOps Engineer
DEVOPS ENGINEER Senior
jobs_results.description:
Company Description

At T-Systems, you will find groundbreaking projects that contribute to social and ecological well-being. We want to welcome new talents like you, who bring fresh ideas, different perspectives, embrace challenges, and are committed to continuous learning in order to grow and make an impact on society... all in a fun way!

It doesn't matter when or where you work. It's about doing meaningful work that advances society. For this reason, we will do everything possible to ensure that you have all the development opportunities by providing a support network, excellent technology, a new work environment, and the freedom to work autonomously. We support you in growing both personally and professionally so that you can make a notable impact on society.

T-Systems is a team of around 28,000 employees worldwide, making us one of the leading global providers of end-to-end integrated solutions. We develop hybrid cloud solutions, artificial intelligence, and drive the digital... transformation of companies, industries, the public sector, and ultimately, society as a whole.

Job Description

CV in English is a must! English level required - C1 (B2+ minimum)

Project:

The developed solution is a cloud-based platform that empowers customers with a sea load of data. Using a SaaS model, the platform securely connects machinery in the field to an Amazon cloud. Moreover, platform delivers the data analytics you need to take fleet confidently into the future.

The platform has customizable dashboards to display the data you can utilize to monitor the operation of your machinery. The data can also be used in other digital products and services provided by us. Data allows to respond with speed and intelligence in emergencies and to proactively consult to prevent issues and optimize operation.

Role: Senior DevOps Engineer

Tasks: Supporting the analytics platform for the data scientists - to accelerate the development of data science activities and abstract data extraction, deployment, etc - (templating to package common functions, eg: windowing of data, scheduling batch execution, versioning)

DevOps tasks - Primarily Infrastructure, Pipelines, Tooling, Integration, Observability

Primary tech stack:

Terraform, AWS, EKS, EFK - elastic search (ellasticstack), CICD pipelines (Jenkins), Helm charts, monitoring, alerting and logging (observability) of Kubernetes and AWS (monitoring of EKS)

Secondary: Graphana, Prometheus, Datadog, Python

Strong softskills is a benefit (communication, proactivity, engagement)

Additional Information

What do we offer you?
• International, positive, dynamic, and motivated work environment.
• Hybrid work model (telework/face-to-face).
• Flexible schedule.
• Continuous training.
• Flexible Compensation Plan.
• Life and accident insurance.
• More than 25 working days of vacation per year.

And many more advantages of being part of T-Systems!

If you are looking for a new challenge, do not hesitate to send us your CV! Please send CV in English. Join our team!

T-Systems Iberia will only process the CVs of candidates who meet the requirements specified for each offer

jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Job Summary :

The selected candidate will be responsible for providing assistance in managing and maintaining the Altair One platform, as well as implementing and deploying applications in both Cloud and On-Premises environments.

They will work closely with the team to ensure smooth and efficient operation of the platform, while also troubleshooting issues as they arise.

The ideal candidate should have a solid understanding of Cloud and On-Premises deployment methods and be able to work collaboratively in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

Job Requirements :

2+ years of experience in DevOps / SRE, systems engineering, build / release / deployment automation, Public / Private / Hybrid cloud deployment, etc.

2+ years of experience in Azure,AWS,GCP, or OCI is necessary.

Strong Docker and Kubernetes skills are required.

Familiarity with working on an Agile / Iterative development framework.

Experience with modern deployment mechanisms like Canary, and Blue Green.

Experience... with Infrastructure as Code Tooling Terraform orAWS CloudFormation orAzure ARM.

Experience with Configuration Management tools such as Salt Stack, Ansible, Chef, and Puppet.

Experience with Application Observability / Metrics Grafana stack, Honeycomb, Prometheus, Loki, etc.

Experience with Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment Pipelines - Jenkins CI, GitLab CI / CD, Flux or ArgoCD.

DevOps tooling (GitLab, Jenkins, GitHub, Jira, Jenkins DSL, Hashi Corp Vault, Consul, Boundary, Istio, Packer,Linkerd, Kapitan, Helm, Kedaetc.)

Experience with Windows and Linux administration.

Understanding of High-PerformanceComputing (HPC) is a plus.

Job Responsibilities :

Debug Production issues by working with the Development and Operations team.

Understand and improve the reliability and scaling of Production deployments.

Deploy microservices on Cloud and On-premises K8s environments.

Provide quick fixes and solutions and rollout software fixes to Production.

Develop scripts to automate routine tasks.

Research innovative technology and solution alternatives to find the best solutions to problems.

Set up monitoring and alerting systems to detect issues before they become problems, ensuring our systems are always available.

Analyse Requirements and proactively estimate and project the requirements for infrastructure, security, and DevOps initiatives.

How You Will Be Successful :
• Envision the Future
• Communicate Honestly and Broadly
• Seek Technology and Business Firsts
• Embrace Diversity and Take Risks

What We Offer :
• Competitive benefits and salary
• A great team with very friendly and highly skilled peers
• Flexible working hours and possibility to work either fully remote, or work from our office in Budapest
• Private health insurance
• Gym membership reimbursement
• Extra vacation days
• SZÉP Card
• Health days in the office with monthly massage

jobs_results.title: DevOps Manager
jobs_results.description:
At AstraZeneca, we are committed to revolutionizing the pharmaceutical industry and making a positive impact on patient lives. As a DevOps Manager, you will play a crucial role in our mission by leading and managing a team of talented individuals responsible for creating and maintaining our software delivery pipeline. We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced individual who is passionate about DevOps principles and has a strong background in software development and infrastructure management. If you are driven, innovative, and dedicated to continuous improvement, we invite you to join our team and help us drive the future of healthcare.

Lead and manage a team of talented individuals responsible for creating and maintaining the software delivery pipeline.
Develop and implement DevOps strategies and best practices to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of software development and delivery processes.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and resolve issues... optimize processes, and drive continuous improvement.
Ensure the reliability, security, and scalability of our software systems and infrastructure.
Monitor and report on the performance of the software delivery pipeline, identifying areas for improvement and implementing solutions.
Manage and prioritize workload and resources to meet project deadlines and deliver high-quality results.
Stay updated on industry trends and advancements in DevOps practices and technologies, and recommend and implement relevant improvements.
Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning within the DevOps team.
Collaborate with other teams within the organization, such as software development, quality assurance, and IT, to ensure smooth and efficient delivery of software products.
Communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels, providing updates, progress reports, and recommendations as needed.

AstraZeneca is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics

jobs_results.title: Cloud DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
The Company

HP is a Fortune 100 technology company with $58+ Billion in revenue, with over 50,000 employees operating in more than 170 countries around the world. We provide technology and services that help people and companies address their problems and challenges, and realize their possibilities, aspirations and dreams. We apply new thinking and ideas to create simpler, more valuable and trusted experiences with technology, continuously improving the way our customers live and work.

Position background

In the GTM analytics COE our mission is to deliver impact by building machine learning products to optimize pricing and marketing investments and provide guidance to our sales organization.

Within the Cloud Infrastructure team, we are ensuring that our Data Science teams have all the technology assets they need to build and deliver the AI/ML solutions they work on as well that our Big Data environment is secure and has an up time of 99.99999%. As a Cloud Engineer you will... contribute to the success of our team thru the development of new solutions, infrastructures, and maintenance of existing ones for which you will ensure their compliance with security policies.

We offer an international experience, collaborative culture, top rate experience in AI and ML and opportunity to create significant real-world impact.

What you will do
• Designs and establishes secure and performant data architectures.
• Deliver enhancements, updates and programming changes for portions and subsystems of infrastructure hosting data pipelines, repositories and models for structured/unstructured data.
• Analyzes design and determines coding, programming, and integration activities required based on general objectives and knowledge of overall architecture of product or solution.
• Write and executes complete testing plans, protocols, and documentation for assigned portion of data system or component.
• Identify, debug and create solutions for issues with code and integration into data system architecture.
• Collaborates and communicates with project team regarding project progress and issue resolution.
• Represents the infrastructure team supporting the data engineering for all phases of larger and more-complex development projects.
• Provides guidance and mentoring to less experienced staff members.
• Investigate and suggest ways to improve and reduce operational costs.

What you will need:
• Bachelor’s in computer engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics or a related field
• 4+ years on a similar role.
• Ability to work under pressure as well as in autonomous mode.
• In-depth knowledge of provisioning and managing on-premises Windows physical and virtual infrastructure using Hyper-V.
• In-depth knowledge of provisioning and managing cloud services on Microsoft Azure.
• Review and Implement DevOps best practices, apply CI and CD principles (best practice) in supporting the build & release life cycle.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with ability to represent complex algorithms in software.
• Strong understanding of database technologies and management systems, in particular Microsoft SQL Server and Azure SQL database services.
• Experience on database architecture testing methodology, including execution of test plans, debugging, and testing scripts and tools.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills; mastery in English and local language.
• Experience designing data systems/solutions to manage complex data and ability to effectively communicate product architectures, design.
• Experience with container orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes.
• Strong experience in at least one of the following languages: Python, Java, C#, .NET Core and .Net framework.
• Experience with IaC frameworks such as Azure Resource Manager, Terraform, Microsoft PowerShell.

Nice to Have
• Experience on Linux Operating Systems.
• Experience on NoSQL databases.
• Experience working on distributed computing systems.
• Experience with different cloud providers systems such as AWS or GCP

Who We Are

At HP, we believe in the power of ideas. We use ideas to put technology to work for everyone. And we believe that ideas thrive best in a culture of teamwork. That is why everyone – at every level in every function, is encouraged to think big, have original ideas and express and share them. We trust anything can be achieved if you really believe in it, and we will invest in your ideas to change lives and the way people work. This vision is what sets us apart as a company. At HP, we work across borders and without limits. Global virtual teams share resources, pool their big ideas to solve our biggest business opportunities. Everyone is valued for the unique skills, experiences and perspective they bring. That’s how we work at HP. And this is how ideas and people grow

jobs_results.title: DevOps Azure
jobs_results.description:
Puesto de trabajo: DevOps Azure

Rango salarial: De 30.000€ - 40.000€

Ubicación: Híbrido Valencia

Que conocimientos requiere el puesto:

Gestión integral de entornos en la nube de Azure, abarcando desde la implementación inicial y configuración de seguridad, como el establecimiento de listas de control de acceso (ACL) y firewalls de aplicación web (WAF), hasta el mantenimiento continuo y el soporte técnico. Incluye la administración de grupos de recursos, la activación y gestión de servicios específicos de Azure según los requisitos del proyecto, así como la realización de copias de seguridad y la gestión de bases de datos PostgreSQL y MySQL.

Funciones del puesto:
• Supervisión y gestión de entornos basados en sistemas Linux/Windows en la plataforma de Azure.
• Implementación y mantenimiento de medidas de seguridad en la nube.
• Configuración y mantenimiento de la infraestructura de red en el entorno de la nube.
• Gestión de recursos diversos en la nube para garantizar su... eficiencia y disponibilidad.

Si te interesa la posición contacta directamente conmigo cristian.ruiz@robertwalters.com

jobs_results.title: Senior Development Operations Engineer
jobs_results.description:
We are looking for a Senior Devops Engineer to join our R&A Devops team in Barcelona, Spain.

This is an amazing opportunity to work on Devops and Data Science related technologies.

The team consists of 6 people and is reporting to the Senior Manager. We have a great skill set in CI/CD, Jenkins, Terraform, Docker/Container, AWS and we would love to speak with you if you have skills in provisioning/managing AWS resources using Devops best practices.

About You – experience, education, skills, and accomplishments
• Bachelor's degree in computer science or similar
• 5+ Year of professional experience in software automation and system administration
• 5+ Year of experience in provisioning resources in AWS or any cloud provider using Terraform.
• Strong experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, or CircleCI.
• Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python, Shell, PowerShell , Groovy
• Hands-on experience with Docker.
• Solid understanding of security best practices and... how to implement them in a DevOps context.
• Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment.

It would be great if you also had . . .
• Work in software design/development and implementation
• Knowledge of Groovy Scripting
• Experience in Data Ops
• Familiarity with Databricks or similar Data Lake tools
• Ability to present the options and solution to stakeholders

What will you be doing in this role?
• Work closely with Development team/Squad
• Represent devops in development team scrum meetings
• Fix issue raised by development team related to IAC or deployment
• Provide solutions for any new feature/service automation requirement
• Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines for application and model deployment and testing.
• Collaborate with data engineers and scientists to build automation based on project requirements.
• Write and review Infrastructure as Code (IAC) provisioning code using Terraform.
• Ensure security best practices are followed early in the development phase.
• Troubleshoot issues related to infrastructure, deployment, and performance.
• Always motivate to learn and share with the team

Product you will be developing

You will be working on creating new services automation for Data Science and R&A (Research and Analytics) based applications. Products include WoS (Web of Science), Incites, JCR etc.

Applications are build using different technologies like Java, Springboot, Angular, DB, ElasticSearch.

About the Team

R&A Devops team consist of 3 Senior Devops Engineer, 3 Devops Engineer and a Manager. Team is distributed in three different timezone: Spain, USA and India.

Team support multiple product lines like WoS, Incites and JCR for automation and Infrastructure. Team also supports automation for newly formed Data Science Team.

Hours of Work

This is a full-time permanent position, CET/CEST hours.

Working on a hybrid model from our Barcelona Office.

What we can offer
• 30 working days of vacation
• Volunteering community, with 40 paid hours of volunteering time
• Private Health and Life & Disability insurances.
• Tax-free benefits (Ticket Restaurant scheme, kindergarten, and transport cards)
• On-site language classes (Catalan, Spanish and English)

At Clarivate, we are committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all persons with respect to hiring, compensation, promotion, training and other terms, conditions and privileges of employment. We comply with applicable laws and regulations governing non-discrimination in all locations

jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer​/Remote
jobs_results.description:
Posición: DevOps Engineer (Remote )

About us:

Have you always wanted to put your passion for education to use on the job? Would you like to work with an incredible team making an impact on learning around the world? If you answered yes, we can't wait to meet you!

And just who are we? Edpuzzle is a leading edtech company with offices in San Francisco and Barcelona and nearly 10 years of history helping teachers find and create exciting, interactive video lessons. Over 80% of U.S. schools and millions of teachers and students in 190+ countries around the world are already using Edpuzzle to make education more equitable and engaging.

About the role:

We’re looking for our next Dev Ops Engineer to join the Security and Infrastructure
Team in Spain
. As a Dev Ops Engineer, you will enhance development pipelines and infrastructure design, as well as ensure new features development reach the end user.

You will be an active member on all technical decisions, working closely with the... Engineering team.

If you’re looking for a meaningful role on a collaborative team, you’ll feel right at home with us.

You’ll also have the opportunity to contribute to our product and our team development, be a part of diverse projects, and stay up to date with the latest software technologies. In the process, you’ll be challenged daily, learn constantly, see the impact of your opinions and work, and grow as a Dev Ops Engineer.

What technologies will you find?

Technically speaking, our product is written in
Java Script and
Node.js
,and data is stored on
MongoDB
,
Elastic Search
and
Redis
. We’re fully hosted on
AWS
which we also use to store, encode, and stream our own pool of videos. We are continuously improving our release pipeline with
CI/CD and Infrastructure as Code
, using technologies like
Git Hub Actions
,
Cloud Formation and
CDK
.

Wondering what it’s like to work at Edpuzzle?

Picture a place where you can connect with your teammates, whether remotely or in person, whenever you need support. A place where one day you're helping shape one of the biggest edtech platforms in the world, and the next day you're doing a team building activity with your coworkers. A place where everyone has been selected because they're the best at what they do, and where your manager and team trust your decisions fully.

A place where you're encouraged to learn and grow because education is the cornerstone of everything we do. Check out the job details below to see if Edpuzzle could be the right fit for you!
About the job:
• We want to hear your voice! Be part of a dynamic multidisciplinary team where everyone can share new ideas, take initiative, and be a self-starter when coming up with creative options to deliver solutions.
• Design cloud infrastructure that is secure, scalable, and highly available on AWS.
• Provision, configure and maintain cloud infrastructure defined as a code.
• Maintain and improve our IT infrastructure, monitoring tools, and the current delivery pipeline.
• Perform root cause analysis for production errors and infrastructure issues.
• Implement automations to achieve continuous integration and continuous deployment.
• Perform rotatory on-call service.
• Have a good understanding of the product functionalities and work closely with the Engineering teams on the building of new features.
• Stay on top of industry best practices and trends, as well as changes to compliance requirements.
• Use your knowledge of Cloud services and Dev Ops best practices to deliver value quickly and safely.
• Seek out opportunities to learn, share and grow continuously.
About you:
• 4 or more years of experience in Dev Ops Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, Cloud System Administration or Cloud Infrastructure Engineering for a high-traffic web-based product
• Good knowledge of Amazon Web Services (AWS)
• Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (CDK, Cloud Formation, Terraform)
• You have a programming background and are familiar with coding principles (in any language)
• Experience with software release management and deployment pipelines (Git, CI/CD)
• You have experience implementing infrastructure projects with zero downtime for a high-traffic web-based product
• You're open-minded about technologies and development
• You’re excited by the opportunity of working in education
• You make all your technology decisions with the final user in mind
• You love learning and mastering technologies
• You can work independently, and manage goals and deadlines effectively.
• You have an excellent ability to communicate your ideas, regardless of the audience
• You feel comfortable communicating in English within an international and multicultural team
• You are based in Spain and have a work permit to work in Spain
Bonus skills:
• You have experience working closely with Engineering and Product teams in the implementation of new features
• JavaScript, Type Script or Node.js code
• No

SQL database administration, such as MongoDB
• Some of these AWS services:
Elastic Beanstalk, Lambda, S3, Step Functions, Batch, WAF, Cloud Formation, CDK
• Monitoring tools (AWS Cloud Watch, New Relic, Datadog, or Open Telemetry)
• Git…
